id: 32_Electrical safety in Microbiology Labs electrical safety laboratory biosafety
title: 微生物实验室的用电安全
source_doc: course/Microbiology Biosafety/32_Electrical safety in Microbiology Labs electrical safety laboratory biosafety.md
author_source: project/Microbiology Biosafety/32_Electrical safety in Microbiology Labs electrical safety laboratory biosafety/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验台前，身后是培养箱、生物安全柜和冰箱，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in a microbiology lab with an incubator, a biological safety cabinet and a refrigerator behind it, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 欢迎来到实验室安全课。
overlay: 微生物实验室的用电安全

shots.scene: 欣欣指着墙上一排插座，插座旁出现闪电图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to a row of wall outlets; a lightning bolt icon appears beside them.
shots.narration: 今天说说实验室里的电。

shots.scene: 阿杰手上湿漉漉的，伸手去插培养箱的插头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, his hands still wet from washing, reaches to plug in an incubator cord.
shots.narration: 阿杰刚洗完手就去插插头。

shots.scene: 小研一把拦住，指着地上的水渍
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student quickly stops him and points to a small puddle on the floor near the outlet.
shots.narration: 小研喊：先擦干手和地面！

shots.scene: 阿杰愣住，头顶出现问号
shots.prompt_en: The young male student freezes, a question mark above his head.
shots.narration: 阿杰说：做微生物的，电也要管？

shots.scene: 电气设备和墙上线路的图标，外面一个盾牌
shots.prompt_en: Icons of lab instruments and wall wiring surrounded by a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 用电安全，就是安全地使用

shots.scene: 盾牌挡住触电、火焰两个图标
shots.prompt_en: The shield blocks a person outline with a lightning bolt and a flame icon. No people.
shots.narration: 电气设备和线路，防触电、防火灾。

shots.scene: 湿手插插头、水渍旁插电的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a wet hand holding a plug and a plug next to a puddle, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 最先记住：水和电，不碰面。

shots.scene: 三个图标：人、仪器、实验记录本
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a person outline, a lab instrument, and a lab notebook. No people.
shots.narration: 用电出事，伤三样：

shots.scene: 三个图标前出现盾牌
shots.prompt_en: A shield appears in front of all three icons. No people.
shots.narration: 人、设备和科研，都要护住。

shots.scene: 插头冒出黄色闪电，人形图标手上发红
shots.prompt_en: A plug giving off yellow sparks; a person outline's hand glows red. No people.
shots.narration: 第一，保护人员。

shots.scene: 破皮电线、外壳破裂的插座图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a frayed power cord with exposed wires and a cracked outlet cover, with red exclamation marks. No people.
shots.narration: 破皮的线、裂开的插座，最容易触电。

shots.scene: 人形图标被盾牌护住，闪电被挡在外面
shots.prompt_en: A shield protects a person outline while a yellow lightning bolt bounces off it. No people.
shots.narration: 用电规范，才能免受触电和伤害。

shots.scene: 墙上插座冒烟，火苗窜起
shots.prompt_en: A wall outlet giving off smoke as a small flame appears. No people.
shots.narration: 第二，预防电气火灾。

shots.scene: 三个图标：老化线路、插满插头、冒烟的仪器
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: old cracked wiring, an outlet overloaded with plugs, and a smoking instrument. No people.
shots.narration: 线路故障、负荷过大、设备故障，

shots.scene: 老李按空白维护卡擦拭培养箱的散热口
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer cleans the vents of an incubator following a blank maintenance card.
shots.narration: 第三，保护设备。

shots.scene: 一台仪器被正确使用、擦拭干净
shots.prompt_en: A clean, well-kept incubator running normally with a green indicator light. No people.
shots.narration: 正确使用、按时维护，

shots.scene: 日历和扳手图标，旁边一台崭新的仪器
shots.prompt_en: A calendar and a wrench icon beside an instrument that still looks brand new. No people.
shots.narration: 设备寿命更长，也不易损坏。

shots.scene: 培养箱指示灯熄灭，里面的培养皿变灰
shots.prompt_en: An incubator with its indicator light off; the culture dishes inside turn grey. No people.
shots.narration: 第四，科研不中断。

shots.scene: 小研看着失败的培养皿和空白记录本叹气
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sighs over failed culture dishes and a blank notebook.
shots.narration: 一次电气事故，几周的培养就白费了。

shots.scene: 王老师举着空白封面的标准册
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator holds up a booklet with a blank cover and an electrical warning sign on it.
shots.narration: 第五，依法合规。

shots.scene: 空白书上浮出天平和闪电图标
shots.prompt_en: A balance-scale icon and a lightning bolt icon float above a blank rule book. No people.
shots.narration: 遵守用电安全法规和指南，

shots.scene: 罚单和红色印章图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a penalty notice and a red stamp, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 满足法律要求，免得罚款受罚。

shots.scene: 火焰旁边的试剂瓶和生物危害标志的培养物
shots.prompt_en: A flame near reagent bottles and culture containers with a biohazard sign. No people.
shots.narration: 第六，防止连带污染环境。

shots.scene: 电气事故的火花旁，河流和树木图标变灰
shots.prompt_en: Beside a sparking electrical icon, a river and a tree icon turn grey. No people.
shots.narration: 防止电气事故污染和破坏环境。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在六格板前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a board with six squares, each with a small icon.
shots.narration: 用电安全，护人、防火、护设备，

shots.scene: 六格板后三格高亮
shots.prompt_en: The last three squares of the board are highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 保科研、守法规、护环境。

shots.scene: 阿杰擦干手，捏住插头插好，旁边地面干燥
shots.prompt_en: The young male student dries his hands and plugs in the incubator properly on a dry floor.
shots.narration: 阿杰说：手干了，地干了，再插电！

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰、小研在实验室挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the young male student and the female graduate student wave goodbye in the lab.
shots.narration: 电要用好，更要用安全，下次见！
